mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM product WHERE del_status = 0
select * From ( select rownum rn, a.* From (SELECT * FROM product WHERE del_status = 0 ORDER BY product_no desc) a ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{start} and #{end}

SELECT AVG(b.sales_item_cost) FROM sales_order a LEFT JOIN sales_item b ON a.sales_no = b.sales_no AND b.product_no = #{product_no} WHERE TRUNC(a.in_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT SUM(b.sales_item_outcnt) FROM sales_order a LEFT JOIN sales_item b ON a.sales_no = b.sales_no AND b.product_no = #{product_no} WHERE TRUNC(a.in_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT product_no, product_name FROM product WHERE del_status = 0 AND LOWER(product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%')
